items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was this prior to starting to work with the Lionel Hamptons and the Maynard Fergusons? ... That was prior to that, yeah.

ctx.x: No, no. I was in music. I didn’t care. We were playing music. They didn’t have to give no food, didn’t have to be no food around. We were – whenever we had a chance to play music, we did it.
Was this prior to starting to work with the Lionel Hamptons and the Maynard Fergusons?
That was prior to that, yeah.
